description: Qryptive agent edit guard: records each file the agent edits and checks the cryptography in them at the end of every turn. Nothing leaves the machine.

hooks.command: sh -c 'g=$1; shift; if [ ! -f "$g" ] || ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Qryptive guard: check did NOT run: python3 or the guard ($g) is missing. Your edits were not checked." >&2; exit 0; fi; python3 "$g" "$@" || { echo "Qryptive guard: check did NOT run: the guard stopped unexpectedly. Your edits were not checked." >&2; exit 0; }' qryptive-guard "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/agent-guard/qryptive_guard.py" record

sh -c 'g=$1; shift; if [ ! -f "$g" ] || ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Qryptive guard: check did NOT run: python3 or the guard ($g) is missing. Your edits were not checked." >&2; exit 0; fi; python3 "$g" "$@" || { echo "Qryptive guard: check did NOT run: the guard stopped unexpectedly. Your edits were not checked." >&2; exit 0; }' qryptive-guard "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/agent-guard/qryptive_guard.py" check --format claude-code
